name: gizza-ai/date-add-subtract
summary: Add or subtract calendar and business-day durations from a date.

tool.description: Add or subtract years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes and seconds from a date or datetime. Supports calendar math with month-end clamping plus business-day mode that skips configurable weekend days and optional holiday dates. Parameters: date (required), operation add|subtract, years/months/weeks/days/hours/minutes/seconds (whole numbers), skip_weekends, weekend_days, and holidays. Returns JSON with the normalized result date/time, weekday, ISO week, day-of-year, moved-day counts, skipped days and a human summary.

date.description: Required. Start date or datetime. Accepts YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS], YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, DD.MM.YYYY, month-name forms, or today/tomorrow/yesterday.

days.description: Whole days to shift. With skip_weekends or holidays, these are working-day steps.

holidays.description: Optional comma, semicolon, or newline separated holiday dates to skip in business-day mode. Use YYYY-MM-DD or another supported date-only format.

hours.description: Whole hours to shift after calendar date math.

minutes.description: Whole minutes to shift after calendar date math.

months.description: Whole calendar months to shift after years. Jan 31 plus one month becomes the last day of February.

operation.description: Whether to add the duration to the start date or subtract it.

seconds.description: Whole seconds to shift after calendar date math.

skip_weekends.description: When true, day and week steps count only Monday-Friday, and a result landing on a weekend rolls in the direction of travel.

weekend_days.description: Which days count as the weekend when skip_weekends is enabled. Use sat-sun for the common Saturday/Sunday weekend, fri-sat for Gulf schedules, or none to skip only listed holidays.

weeks.description: Whole weeks to shift. In business-day mode, each week means seven working-day steps.

years.description: Whole calendar years to shift. Years and months are applied first and clamp the day-of-month when needed.
